written_after_answers: Rule v3 and this bar were written after the stage 2 answers, v2 and an outside real answer check were all seen. Not pre-registered.
product_labels_note: Written after the answers. Even with the bar met, no v3 label is a validated product label.
reading: The bar was met. This shows the first branch can fire for a panel holding the real answers and not for a stand-in panel on age and sex at these seeds. The rule was still written after the answers, so a label here is a reading of data already seen.

real_answers.note: Each respondent's real answer stands in as the panel's answer in every slot. The 4 slots are identical by construction, so they are one result shown 4 times. Not a claim about any LLM.

surrogate.note: Train split age and sex logistic plus a shift and noise, rng seed 1. It holds no LLM answer and no information beyond age and sex.

distorted_real_answers_sensitivity.note: Real answers at logit strength 3 with each slot's stand-in shift and noise, so the slots differ. Not part of the bar.
